scientific_integrity: Novelty and priority remain provisional pending external historical review; foundational stochastic growth and rank-one correction methods credited to predecessor literature; no empirical biological confirmation claimed.
scientific_limitations: Deterministic two-stage positive rank-one recruitment with common diagonal retention and a strict opposed recruitment tradeoff; does not imply stochastic Markov correlation monotonicity or higher-dimensional results.
title: A unique survival threshold reverses the advantage of environmental persistence in a two-stage population
